blocks.task_summary: Show sin 2x + cos 2x - 1 = 2 sin x (cos x - sin x) using double angle formulas.
method_path: apply double angle formula for sin 2x or cos 2x
simplify to 2 sin x cos x - 2 sin^2 x
factor to 2 sin x (cos x - sin x)
accepted_alternatives: METHOD 1 (LHS to RHS): apply double angle formulas to LHS, simplify, factor
METHOD 2 (RHS to LHS): expand RHS, apply double angle formulas to obtain LHS

evidence.basis: M1: attempt double angle formula; A1: 2 sin x cos x - 2 sin^2 x; both METHODS 1 and 2 explicitly accepted; note: do not award A1 for proofs working from both sides to a common expression other than 2 sin x cos x - 2 sin^2 x

blocks.task_summary: Solve sin 2x + cos 2x - 1 + cos x - sin x = 0 for 0 < x < 2pi using part (a).
method_path: substitute identity to get 2 sin x (cos x - sin x) + cos x - sin x = 0
factor to (cos x - sin x)(2 sin x + 1) = 0
solve cos x = sin x giving tan x = 1, x = pi/4, 5pi/4

evidence.basis: M1: attempt to factorise; A1: (cos x - sin x)(2 sin x + 1) = 0; (M1): recognition sin/cos = tan = 1 or sin x = -1/2; (A1): one correct reference angle pi/4 or pi/6; A2: four solutions 7pi/6, 11pi/6, pi/4, 5pi/4 with A1 for any two correct
